mentions.name: BAML
mentions.description: BAML is a programming language that is embeddable in other programming languages, with a type system similar to TypeScript and a runtime similar to Go. It is currently used for structured outputs with LLMs, with orchestration and more planned, and the team is working on making the language Turing-complete with an early access preview for interested users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We are working on making our programming language BAML turing-complete. https://github.com/boundaryml/baml

It is a language that is embeddable in other programming languages, with the type system similar to typescript, and a runtime that is similar to Go.

People use it currently for structured outputs with llms but soon we will support orchestration and more.
